title: Total influence as expected derivative squares
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every real-valued function $f$ on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, its total influence is the uniform expectation of the sum of the squares of its coordinate discrete derivatives: $\\operatorname{Inf}_{\\mathrm{tot}}(f)=\\mathbb{E}_{x\\sim\\mathrm{Unif}(\\{-1,1\\}^n)}\\sum_{i=1}^n (\\partial_i f(x))^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional cube
